title: Golden color key penalizes compliance with the workbook's color legend
evidence: Cover!D7:E7 specifies 'Hard Codes' as '0, 0, 255' (blue). However, both the input and golden workbook leave LBO!Q15:V15 (hardcoded zeros) and LBO!J21:N21 (hardcoded 1.8 values) black. These are eleven numeric hardcodes within the model itself. Recoloring only these eleven cells in an otherwise golden fixture produces a regression ratio of 0.9975, below the verifier's 0.998 threshold, while all modification checks still pass. Consequently, following the seeded legend causes the sole verifier, weighted 100%, to award zero.
confirmation: Verified in the golden: LBO!Q15 (0) and J21:N21 (1.8) are numeric hardcodes in font FF000000 despite the legend's blue for hard codes. Recolouring these 11 cells, as the audit prompt invites, drops regression to 0.9975 and scores 0.
fix: gt_03_golden.xlsx now also recolours the cells QA named to the Cover legend (font colour only, edited at the XML level; no values, formulas or other styles changed): LBO!J21:N21 and Q15:V15 hard codes black -> 0000FF; LBO!C36 (=SUM, a formula) blue -> 000000; LBO!J62:N62 same-sheet links black -> 7030A0; 'Valuation Bridge'!C3:C4 cross-sheet links black -> 00B050; the black numeric hard codes in 'Ex 3 - Balance Sheet' (90), 'Ex 11 - Multiples' (167) and 'Ex 10 - Forecast Assumptions ' (92) -> 0000FF. 368 cells in all; they are now graded again. Still left out of answer_position: LBO!F14, F21 and 'Valuation Bridge'!C5:C7 (named, but they mix cross-sheet links with arithmetic, so the legend gives no single colour: the model itself colours such cells green in C22 and black elsewhere), plus the earlier exclusion of the other, unnamed legend violations and ambiguous mixed formulas (282 cells, was 650). Checked with the real SB2 scorer (font_color mode): new key vs itself 1.0; untouched input plus the 9 planted and 368 named recolours 1.0; the golden with every violation recoloured to the legend 1.0; untouched input 0.0; planted-only recolouring (the old key) now fails (mod 0.0239), as expected.

title: Answer key recolours only 9 cells but leaves about 630 other colour-legend violations, so a thorough colour fix fails the regression check
evidence: The Cover sheet legend (Cover!D5:E9) says: 'Hard Codes' 0,0,255; 'Link to Different Cell in Same Sheet' 112,48,160; 'Link to Different Cell in Different Sheet' 0,176,80; 'Formulas' black. The answer key (gt_03_golden.xlsx) differs from the input in only 9 graded cells: LBO!F11, F12, F13 and F20 become purple 7030A0, and LBO!J27:N27 become blue. I applied the Cover legend to the answer key and it still breaks the legend in about 630 graded cells. Examples inside LBO alone: J21:N21 are hardcoded 1.8 in black; F14 and F21 are links to another sheet in black; C36 '=SUM(C28:C29)' is a formula in blue; J62:N62 are same-sheet links ('=I62', etc.) in black. In Valuation Bridge, C3:C7 link to LBO and are black. The raw-data sheets hold hundreds of hardcoded figures in black: Ex 3 has 90 such cells, Ex 11 has 167 and Ex 10 Forecast Assumptions has 101. The verifier (font_color mode) passes a run only if every modified cell matches AND at least 99.8% of regression cells match. There are 4,457 graded cells, so the agent may differ from the answer key on at most about 8 unchanged cells. An agent that applies the stated legend consistently, even only across LBO (19 extra cells), scores 0. This rejects valid answers (multiple_valid_answers_rejected): the answer key itself is an inconsistent application of the convention it grades.
confirmation: The Cover legend sets Hard Codes = 0,0,255 and same-sheet links = 112,48,160, yet gt_03_golden.xlsx keeps LBO!J21:N21 (hardcoded 1.8) black, J62 (=I62) black and C36 (=SUM) blue, while only 9 cells change. A thorough legend-consistent recolour therefore exceeds the 0.998 regression tolerance in font
